<includeonly>{{#df_tagvalue:{{{1}}}|{{{2}}}|{{{3|0}}}|{{{notfound|not found}}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>
Usage: <nowiki>{{ tagvalue | raw entry | tag name | number | notfound=placeholder text }}</nowiki>

Returns: value associated to that tag. uses the (N+1)th (default first) tag encountered. If the tag is not found, the "notfound" parameter specifies what gets returned (defaults to "not found").

[[category:raw templates]]
</noinclude>
